title: Here's how to use intelligent dictation in Gemini for macOS.
gist: Google added an OS-level intelligent dictation feature to the Gemini app for macOS that transcribes speech into any desktop window with automatic filler-word removal and correction handling, extending Gemini from a standalone chat app into a system-wide input layer on Apple's own operating system.

themes.theme: Gemini expands into OS-level input on macOS

insights.claim: Google's Gemini app for macOS now offers intelligent dictation that lets users speak into any window on the desktop, not just inside the Gemini app itself, with transcribed text dropped directly at the cursor.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: By working across any application window rather than being confined to its own app, Gemini is positioning itself as a system-level utility on macOS rather than a siloed chat product, directly competing with Apple's native dictation and Siri.
insights.quote: This intelligent dictation feature allows you to speak naturally into any window on your desktop, transcribing your spoken words into clean, polished text.

insights.claim: The dictation feature automatically removes filler words ('ums' and 'ahs') and handles mid-sentence corrections before inserting the final polished text, going beyond raw speech-to-text transcription toward cleaned, publish-ready output.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Automatic disfluency removal and correction handling is a meaningful UX differentiator versus basic OS dictation tools, relevant to how Google differentiates Gemini on quality rather than just availability.
insights.quote: It automatically removes the "ums" and "ahs," catches mid-sentence corrections, and drops the formatted text instantly at your cursor.

insights.claim: The Gemini app is being extended with a system-level, cross-application input feature on macOS rather than a capability confined to its own chat interface, signaling a strategy of embedding Gemini into users' everyday desktop workflows rather than keeping it a destination app.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Watch for continued investment in cross-application, OS-embedded Gemini features as a distribution strategy to increase desktop engagement beyond the standalone chat app.
